title: "Figure 4 and Table 1"
output: html_notebook

Download libraries.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

Download RData from the folder.
```{r}
# Load RData file containing data required for analysis and visualization.
load("multiple_cohorts_data.RData")

source("FunctionCollection.R")

# Define a list of datasets (unique study ID)
datasets <- c("PHS000452_GSE91061","PRJEB23709","SU2CMARK")

# The clinical and gene expression data is stored as df_tf.
df_tf <- df_tf %>%
  distinct(SampleID, StudyID, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_C1_pre <- df_tf %>% 
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") %>%
  dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_C2_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[2] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_NSCLC_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[3] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

# Combine all pre-tx samples from three cohorts
df_pre <- rbind(df_C1_pre, df_C2_pre, df_NSCLC_pre)
```


```{r}
# Define list of immune cell type
cell_types <- c("B.cells.naive","B.cells.memory","Plasma.cells",
                "T.cells.CD8","T.cells.CD4.naive","T.cells.CD4.memory.resting","T.cells.CD4.memory.activated",
                "T.cells.follicular.helper","T.cells.regulatory..Tregs.","T.cells.gamma.delta",
                "NK.cells.resting","NK.cells.activated",
                "Monocytes","Macrophages.M0","Macrophages.M1","Macrophages.M2",
                "Dendritic.cells.resting","Dendritic.cells.activated",
                "Mast.cells.resting","Mast.cells.activated",
                "Eosinophils","Neutrophils"
                )

```

Cohort 1 Pre-Tx 50% IRF2 - Plot immune cell fractions.
```{r}
df_in <- df_pre %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1] & BiopsyTime == "Pre")

Fig4_C1_P50 <- plot_cell_fraction_boxplot(df = df_in,
                                      gene_col = "IRF2", 
                                      cell_types = cell_types,
                                      cohort_col = "StudyID", 
                                      cohort = datasets[1],
                                      split_pct = 50, 
                                      subgroup_col = NULL, 
                                      norm_type = "log2"
)

Fig4_C1_P50
```


Cohort 2 Pre-Tx 50% IRF2 - Plot immune cell fractions.
```{r}
df_in <- df_pre %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[2] & BiopsyTime == "Pre")

Fig4_C2_P50 <- plot_cell_fraction_boxplot(df = df_in,
                           gene_col = "IRF2", 
                           cell_types = cell_types,
                           cohort_col = "StudyID", 
                           cohort = datasets[2],
                           split_pct = 50, 
                           subgroup_col = NULL, 
                           norm_type = "log2"
                           )

Fig4_C2_P50
```

Cohort NSCLC Pre-Tx 50% IRF2 - Plot immune cell fractions.
```{r}
df_in <- df_pre %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[3] & BiopsyTime == "Pre")

Fig4_NSCLC_P50 <- plot_cell_fraction_boxplot(df = df_in,
                           gene_col = "IRF2", 
                           cell_types = cell_types,
                           cohort_col = "StudyID", 
                           cohort = datasets[3],
                           split_pct = 50, 
                           subgroup_col = NULL, 
                           norm_type = "log2"
                           )

Fig4_NSCLC_P50
```

```{r}
Fig4 <- ggarrange(Fig4_C1_P50, 
                  Fig4_C2_P50, 
                  Fig4_NSCLC_P50,
                  nrow = 3, ncol = 1, common.legend = TRUE)

Fig4
```

```{r}
# Perform correlation analysis
df_corr_Cells_IRF2 <- compute_gene_cell_correlation(df = df_pre, 
                                                    gene_col = "IRF2", 
                                                    cell_types = cell_types, 
                                                    cohort_col = "StudyID", 
                                                    cohorts = datasets, 
                                                    norm_type = "log2")

# Build table output
Table1 <- build_gene_cell_correlation_table(df_corr_Cells_IRF2, 
                                            cell_types = cell_types)

Table1
```
